scope: Additive Grand Warden attacking air-mode movement contract. It does not infer an aura, equipment effect, defensive Hero Banner behavior, animation or timing not present in the source.

sources.title: Pinned Grand Warden description
sources.limitations: The source says the Grand Warden can walk or fly over Walls, but does not define the UI toggle, transition timing, aura, exact collision shape or defensive Banner operation.

behavior_contract.implemented: An explicit value-serialized ArmySlot mode materializes the existing Grand Warden base attack as flying. Fixed-tick movement then uses the shared flying route, so walls do not determine its route.
non_derivations: No movement speed, attack, range, aura, target priority or projectile property is changed.
No ground-mode wall-jump behavior is inferred.

items: in-game mode selection and transition timing

conclusion: The source-backed attacking air mode is available through the same Core scenario, Headless, Viewer and replay paths. All other undocumented Grand Warden behavior remains partial.
